To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Zachman Framework principles can be employed as an ontology to support agile modelling and that the agile modelling tool developed provides a proof-of-concepts for the implementation of the Zachman Framework ontology.

the proposed agile modelling tool can be used to implement an enterprise model-driven software engineering method which is able to cover multiple facets of enterprise models and to provide hyperlinks between them.
the Zachman Framework is a useful ontology to guide the design of an agile modelling tool and that semantic technology can be used to extend the coverage of the tool.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an agile modelling tool, which implements an Agile Modelling Method, and the use of this tool in the context of Model-Driven Software Engineering.
the development of a modelling tool which implements an agile modelling approach and which can be extended with respect to the modelling of additional enterprise facets.

the development and evaluation of an agile modelling tool for model-driven software engineering, which is based on the Zachman Framework, and which provides a means to integrate models created with different modelling methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Zachman Framework is a valuable tool for the conceptualisation of an enterprise, and that its principles are a valuable source for the development of a domain-specific modelling language and method.
the proposed tool and its associated modelling method provide an agile approach to enterprise modelling which can support the creation of a variety of enterprise models.

we have developed a tool that allows us to capture the different views and abstractions of an enterprise and to link them together in a way that makes them available for semantic queries and machine processing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a modelling tool which implements an agile modelling method, which is based on the Zachman Framework and which is further coupled with Semantic Web technologies.
the tool developed can be used as a starting point to create models of different enterprise facets, and that these models can be linked together to create a holistic view of the enterprise.
the Zachman Framework can serve as a starting point for the creation of domain-specific modelling methods and the implementation of corresponding modelling tools.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Zachman Framework provides a good starting point for modelling the various aspects of an enterprise and that it can be further extended with respect to Agile Modelling Method engineering.
the Zachman Framework can serve as a starting point for the design of an enterprise model-driven engineering approach.
the Zachman Framework can provide a useful ontology for model-driven engineering of enterprises.
